items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: p0seid0n design tokens: the nine --p0seid0n-* colours, control and panel radii, popup shadow, and the Tailwind v4 @theme inline bridge.
items.docs: Import the stylesheet once, in the same file that imports Tailwind. Light and dark follow color-scheme: the OS preference by default, or a .light or .dark class on the html element. There are no dark: variants, so overriding any --p0seid0n-* value re-themes every component, including at runtime.

items.name: theme-shadcn
items.title: Theme (shadcn aliases)
items.description: Optional compatibility stylesheet mapping standard shadcn CSS variables and Tailwind v4 colour tokens onto --p0seid0n-* variables.
items.docs: Import after styles/p0seid0n.css when mixing p0seid0n components with existing shadcn-vue components that reference --background, --foreground, bg-card or bg-destructive.

items.name: utils
items.title: Utils
items.description: The cn() class merge helper built on clsx and tailwind-merge.
items.docs: Import cn from your lib alias. It merges conditional classes with clsx and resolves Tailwind conflicts with tailwind-merge.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Ink-filled primary, control-grey secondary, transparent ghost and danger button in three sizes, with loading and leading/trailing slots.
items.docs: Use variant primary, secondary, ghost or danger and size sm, md or lg. Loading sets aria-busy, disables interaction and leaves the progress slot usable. Use the leading and trailing slots for icons; the component ships none. A click handler passed from the parent is not called while loading or disabled.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Small labelling chip in neutral, accent, accent-alt and outline variants.
items.docs: Pick a variant with the variant prop. Text stays at the smallest type step so a badge never competes with the value it labels.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: One-pixel rule in a line colour, horizontal or vertical.
items.docs: Set orientation to vertical inside a flex row; the rule stretches to the container height. It is decorative by default and hidden from assistive tech; set decorative to false to expose a separator role.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Panel container with a raised or surface appearance, plus header, content and footer sections.
items.docs: The panel radius is 16px and the border uses the line colour. appearance raised is the default for cards on the page background; use surface for panels nested inside a raised container. CardHeader takes title, description and action slots, and its default slot fills the title.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Text field with a focus ring, an aria-driven invalid state and a disabled state.
items.docs: Bind with v-model. Set invalid to render aria-invalid and the danger border. Give it an id and point a Label at the same value so the two stay associated.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Caption that associates with a control through its for attribute, with an optional required marker.
items.docs: Pass for with the id of the control. required appends a decorative asterisk in the danger colour; it is hidden from assistive tech, so keep the native required or aria-required attribute on the control itself.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Two-state control built on reka-ui, in md and lg sizes with an optional slot inside the thumb.
items.docs: Bind with v-model. Space and Enter toggle it and aria-checked follows the value. The thumb slot is empty by default so an icon can be passed without adding a dependency. Transitions are dropped under prefers-reduced-motion.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Menu root, trigger and popup with plain, checkbox and radio items, labels, separators and groups.
items.docs: Control open state with v-model:open when needed. Arrow keys move between items, Enter selects, Esc closes and focus returns to the trigger. DropdownMenuContent takes align, side and sideOffset; its minWidth defaults to 160px and its z-index is 50 so menus inside dialogs sit above the dialog. Radio items must sit inside DropdownMenuRadioGroup. Use the trigger's asChild prop to wrap the Button item instead of a raw button.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Delayed hover and focus hint with four sides and an optional shortcut hint.
items.docs: Control open state with v-model:open when needed. The tip opens after the delay prop (300ms by default) on both hover and keyboard focus, and Escape dismisses it. The trigger points aria-describedby at the tip content while it is open. Pass shortcut to append a key hint such as K.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Centered modal with overlay, title, description and a built-in close control.
items.docs: Bind with v-model:open. The panel sets role dialog with modal behaviour, locks background scroll and traps Tab inside. Escape and outside clicks close it unless closeOnEsc or closeOnOutside are false. Always render DialogTitle; it becomes the accessible name. Set hideClose on DialogContent when the panel supplies its own dismiss control.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Trigger strip and panels with arrow key navigation.
items.docs: Bind with v-model and give each TabsTrigger and TabsContent a matching value. Arrow keys move within the strip, Home and End jump to the ends. activationMode automatic switches on arrow key, manual waits for Enter or Space. Panels stay mounted by default so form state survives a tab change.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Self-contained notification stack with a provider, useToast composable and three variants.
items.docs: Wrap the app in ToastProvider, then call useToast().toast({ title, description, variant, action, duration }). The provider keeps at most max notifications (3 by default) and drops the oldest first; duration defaults to 4000ms, pauses on hover or focus, and zero keeps one open. variant danger uses the theme danger colour and role alert. The stack teleports to body at z-60 so it stays above dialogs.

items.name: sparkline
items.title: Sparkline
items.description: Hand-written SVG bar strip for a numeric series, with median-based scaling and an optional baseline.
items.docs: Pass values as a number array; the component never formats labels for you. Bars fill 60% of each slot and the series is pinned to the right edge when slots is larger than the data. The value axis is capped at median x 3 so a few spikes cannot flatten the rest; with one or two samples it falls back to the maximum. An empty array renders no path but keeps its size, a single sample renders one full-height bar. Set ariaLabel to expose role img; without it the graphic is aria-hidden.

items.name: stat
items.title: Stat
items.description: Label, condensed tabular value and unit, with an inline figure slot for a sparkline.
items.docs: Values are preformatted strings, so locale and rounding stay with you. A null, undefined or empty value renders emptyText in the faint ink colour and hides the unit. tone colours the value: default ink, accent, or accent-alt which maps to the theme danger colour. Drop a Sparkline into the figure slot; it is baseline aligned with the value.

items.name: theme-provider
items.title: Theme Provider
items.description: Three-state theme state (system, light, dark) with a matching inline script for the first paint.
items.docs: Wrap the app in ThemeProvider and read state with useTheme(): theme is the stored choice, resolvedTheme is what is painted. setTheme writes localStorage only when the choice changes, and system removes the key when defaultTheme is system so the OS preference keeps driving the page. Inline the themeScript() string in head before your bundle to avoid a flash on reload; it only touches the html element, so hydration has nothing to disagree with.

items.name: theme-switcher
items.title: Theme Switcher
items.description: Ghost button opening a radio menu with system, light and dark choices.
items.docs: Requires a ThemeProvider above it and uses useTheme(), so the menu, the html class and localStorage always agree. The icon slot receives the current choice for rendering a matching icon. Labels default to System, Light and Dark and can be overridden per locale.
